zh.name: 步离战首•呼雷（完整）
zh.desc: 代码受到影响后的完整投影。参照本体为犯尽十恶，永镇于幽狱之底的步离人首领。\n身负七百年苦狱仇恨，在脱出牢笼后，群狼之主向整个罗浮仙舟发起了挑战。但潜藏在疯狂之举的背后，似乎另有目标……

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体造成雷属性伤害。
对指定我方单体及相邻目标造成雷属性伤害。
使除自身外的所有目标行动延后，并造成少量雷属性伤害。
对我方全体造成雷属性伤害，并有概率为我方全体附上【<u>恐惧萦绕</u>】。

220330102.name: 恐惧萦绕
220330102.desc: 第二个回合开始时陷入【恐惧】状态，在此之前对施加者发起一次攻击可解除【恐惧萦绕】。

220330103.name: 恐惧
220330103.desc: 无法行动，持续至自身下个回合开始。

skill_list.skill_desc: 对指定我方单体造成大量雷属性伤害，并大概率为其附上【<u>恐惧萦绕</u>】。

220330102.name: 恐惧萦绕
220330102.desc: 第二个回合开始时陷入【恐惧】状态，在此之前对施加者发起一次攻击可解除【恐惧萦绕】。

220330103.name: 恐惧
220330103.desc: 无法行动，持续至自身下个回合开始。

skill_list.skill_desc: 当敌方施放攻击后，为<u>能够进入【月狂】状态的敌方单位</u>附加1层【<u>嗜血</u>】，当【<u>嗜血</u>】达到指定层时，将使其进入【<u>月狂</u>】状态。\n行动序列上出现【月狂】倒计时，倒计时回合开始时所有敌方单位解除【<u>月狂</u>】状态。

220320101.name: 能够进入【月狂】状态的敌方单位
220320101.desc: 能够进入【月狂】状态的敌方单位：玄爪狼卒、 蚀月狼卒、咆哮灵柩、咆哮灵柩（错误）、步离战首•呼雷、步离战首•呼雷（完整）。

220320103.name: 嗜血
220320103.desc: 所有能够进入【月狂】的敌方单位共享【嗜血】层数。当有能够进入【月狂】的敌方单位进入战斗时，将附加相同层数的【嗜血】。回合结束时，若场上所有能够进入【月狂】的敌方单位均被击败，清除所有【嗜血】层数。

220340101.name: 月狂
220340101.desc: 此状态下，呼雷的速度提高，且会施放额外技能。当呼雷在场时，强化【玄爪狼卒】和【蚀月狼卒】的月狂效果。呼雷被弱点击破时解除此状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 当呼雷进入【<u>月狂</u>】状态时，每当敌方施放攻击后，为呼雷附加1层【怒意】，若为呼雷攻击，则额外附加1层【怒意】。每当敌方目标以外的目标施放攻击后，将减少1层【怒意】。【怒意】拥有初始层数，当【怒意】层数叠加到一定值时，呼雷将释放【贪狼逐驰，血色临照】并清除所有【怒意】层数。每当【怒意】由于我方角色攻击被减少至0层时，将削减呼雷的韧性，并重置【怒意】层数为指定层。

220340101.name: 月狂
220340101.desc: 此状态下，呼雷的速度提高，且会施放额外技能。当呼雷在场时，强化【玄爪狼卒】和【蚀月狼卒】的月狂效果。呼雷被弱点击破时解除此状态。

skill_list.skill_desc: 在行动序列上添加【召集狼群】，每次【召集狼群】行动时，召唤【玄爪狼卒】或【蚀月狼卒】。
进入三阶段后，【召集狼群】的速度将会提高，且在进入三阶段后立即进入【<u>月狂</u>】状态。
每当呼雷使用【雷动风咆，摧枯灭朽】时，将使自身造成的伤害提高。

en.name: Borisin Warhead: Hoolay (Complete)
en.desc: A complete projection produced by compromised codes. The referent entity is a borisin leader who committed the Ten Unpardonable Sins, eternally imprisoned at the bottom of The Shackling Prison.\nBearing the hatred of seven centuries of bitter confinement, the Lord of Wolves challenges the entire Xianzhou Luofu upon breaking free from his cage. Yet, there seems to be another objective hidden behind his maddened actions...

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals Lightning DMG to one designated target.
Deals Lightning DMG to one designated target and adjacent units.
Causes all targets (except this unit) to have their action delayed and deals minor Lightning DMG.
Deals Lightning DMG to all targets with a high chance of applying "<u>Terror Grip</u>" on all targets.

220330102.name: Terror Grip
220330102.desc: Enters the "Terrified" state at the start of the second turn. Attacking the caster 1 time before then can dispel "Terror Grip."

220330103.name: Terrified
220330103.desc: Unable to take action until the start of this unit's next turn.

skill_list.skill_desc: Deals massive Lightning DMG to one designated target, with a high chance of inflicting "<u>Terror Grip</u>."

220330102.name: Terror Grip
220330102.desc: Enters the "Terrified" state at the start of the second turn. Attacking the caster 1 time before then can dispel "Terror Grip."

220330103.name: Terrified
220330103.desc: Unable to take action until the start of this unit's next turn.

skill_list.skill_desc: After a friendly unit launches an attack, apply 1 stack of "<u>Bloodlust</u>" to <u>friendly units who can enter the "Moon Rage" state</u>. When "<u>Bloodlust</u>" reaches a certain number of stacks, the friendly unit enters the "<u>Moon Rage</u>" state.\nA "Moon Rage" countdown icon appears in the Action Order. When the countdown's turn begins, "<u>Moon Rage</u>" is dispelled across all friendly units.

220320101.name: Enemy units that can enter "Moon Rage"
220320101.desc: Enemy units that can enter "Moon Rage": Sableclaw Wolftrooper, Eclipse Wolftrooper, Howling Casket, Howling Casket (Bug), Borisin Warhead: Hoolay, Borisin Warhead: Hoolay (Complete).

220320103.name: Bloodlust
220320103.desc: All enemy units that can enter "Moon Rage" will share "Bloodlust" stacks. When enemy units that can enter "Moon Rage" join the battle, the same number of "Bloodlust" stacks will be applied to them. At the end of the turn, if all enemies that can enter "Moon Rage" have been defeated, clears all "Bloodlust" stacks.

220340101.name: Moon Rage
220340101.desc: In this state, Hoolay's SPD increases, and he can use additional abilities. While Hoolay is on the battlefield, "Sableclaw Wolftroopers'" and "Eclipse Wolftroopers'" Moon Rage state is enhanced. Hoolay will leave this state upon being Weakness Broken.

skill_list.skill_desc: While Hoolay is in the "<u>Moon Rage</u>" state, applies 1 stack of "Irate" to Hoolay after every attack launched by friendly units. If Hoolay uses an attack, additionally applies 1 stack of "Irate." After every attack used by a target aside from a friendly unit, reduces 1 stack of "Irate." "Irate" has an initial set of stacks. When a certain number of "Irate" stacks is reached, Hoolay will use "Lupine Chase Calls Bloody Gleam" and remove all "Irate" stacks. Whenever "Irate" stacks are reduced to 0 due to attacks from characters, Hoolay's Toughness will be reduced and reset "Irate" to a set number of stacks.

220340101.name: Moon Rage
220340101.desc: In this state, Hoolay's SPD increases, and he can use additional abilities. While Hoolay is on the battlefield, "Sableclaw Wolftroopers'" and "Eclipse Wolftroopers'" Moon Rage state is enhanced. Hoolay will leave this state upon being Weakness Broken.

skill_list.skill_name: To My Howls the Pack Obeys
skill_list.skill_desc: Adds "Summon the Pack" to the Action Order. Whenever "Summon the Pack" takes action, summons "Sableclaw Wolftrooper" or "Eclipse Wolftrooper."
After entering Phase 3, the SPD of "Summon the Pack" will increase, and this unit will immediately enter the "<u>Moon Rage</u>" state when entering Phase 3.
Increases Hoolay's DMG dealt whenever Hoolay uses "Decimation of Roaring Storms."
